Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: OpenLib — GitHub integration & demo request

Hi Camila,

I signed up for Redwood via the self-serve flow this morning (great onboarding!) and saw you have notes about a GitHub integration in the docs. We're exploring using Redwood to run model inference as part of our CI/CD and GitHub Actions pipelines — especially around PR checks that call a small summarization model.

Quick questions:
- Do you have an existing Actions / GitHub App integration or example repo?
- What are the recommended models/latency profiles for short PR-line summaries (<=128 tokens)?
- Would love to schedule a short demo to see the admin/ops side and ask about dedicated capacity for an initial pilot.

Availability for a 30m demo: I have windows Mon/Tue next week 10–2 PT, otherwise flexible.

Thanks,
Jordan Park
Engineering Manager, OpenLib
jordan@openlib.org
https://github.com/openlib

Hi Jordan — great to meet you and thanks for signing up! I’m Camila (SDR) at Redwood. Happy to set up a quick 30m demo and loop in Alex (AE) to cover pricing/dedicated capacity options.

Short answers to your questions:
- We don’t yet have a packaged GitHub App, but we have reference GitHub Actions and an example repo that teams use. I can share the repo link in the demo.
- For short PR summaries we typically recommend a small-to-medium instruction-tuned model at 3–10ms/token on our hosted endpoints; if you need <200ms tail latency we can discuss Dedicated capacity and quantized variants.

Proposed times (PT):
- Mon 2027-03-29 10:30–11:00
- Tue 2027-03-30 11:00–11:30
- Tue 2027-03-30 14:00–14:30

If none of those work, tell me two windows that do and I’ll coordinate. Also: any specific repo or workflow you'd like us to look at in advance?

Best,
Camila Reyes
Sales Development Representative, Redwood Inference

Thanks Camila — Tue 2027-03-30 11:00 PT works for us.

For context, our repo is https://github.com/openlib/openlib-infra — we use GitHub Actions to run linters/tests and would like to add a step that calls a Redwood endpoint to produce PR summaries and short risk flags. We’re most interested in:
- Examples of a Actions workflow that streams output (so checks don’t block too long)
- Cost per PR at ~200 tokens output on average
- Options for an initial pilot (hosted API vs. Dedicated) and how easy it is to move to Dedicated if needed

Also happy to have Alex join. See you Tue 11:00 PT — can you send a calendar invite?

—Jordan
